## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For editor changes, include the Notepad++ version, light/dark native smoke results, and relevant screenshots. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Review

- [ ] The change follows [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/JDeffner/px-toolkit-notepadpp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed behavior, or no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] New code and fixtures can be contributed under the project license; required third-party notices are included.
- [ ] No generated binaries, credentials, private data, or proprietary game assets are included.
